title: Not effective
text: Not effective. Received this at a price reduction when purchased with the squeeze juicer ( which was excellent).  It may work with hard cheese, but for zesting lemons it’s a total flop. The little teeth can’t get a purchase in the rind.  Sadly I can not recommend this.

product_metadata.title: Zulay Kitchen Cheese Grater & Zester - Stainless Steel Lemon Zester Tool - Zester for Kitchen - Cheese Grater Handheld - Chocolate, Coconut, Nutmeg, Ginger, Lemon Zester - Citrus Zester (Green)
features: Effortlessly Grates Anything & Built To Last: This Grater-Zester-Shredder tool has a razor-sharp top quality stainless steel blade that will not rust and can handle anything you find in the kitchen. The comfortable, non-slip handle and its curved sides make it extremely easy to use. Food grade 304 Stainless Steel.

Grate & Zest Anything: Grate lemon, nutmeg, ginger, garlic, parmesan cheese, pecorino cheese, Romano cheese, gouda cheese, oranges, meyer lemons, limes, key limes, grapefruit, chocolate, hazelnuts, coconut, even cashews if you really want to get inventive.

Get Your Grate On: You can grate or zest nutmeg, chocolate, ginger, parmesan cheese, gouda cheese, oranges, Meyer lemons, limes, key limes, grapefruit, hazelnuts, coconut, cashews and more.  Works as well as a nutmeg grinder, cheese shredder or parmesan cheese grater.

Make Zesting & Grating Fun Again: With this design, even the hardest of cheese will bend to your will with simple passes on the grater. Oranges, lemons and limes alike will shed their zest for you easier than ever. You can have finally rasp almost anything, including nutmeg, coconut, ginger, vegetables like carrots, garlic or potatoes.

No Hassle, Zulay Guarantee: If this is not the best grater you have ever used, simply email us and we will provide a full refund or free replacement. Zulay Kitchen provides a lifetime warranty and satisfaction guarantee on all products, because we know they are great and last forever. Happy Zesting!
